notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.5v
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][p]Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed errors and bugs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed partial material penetration display issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed oversized collision areas in some scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombie overlapping and rotation issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shotgun sometimes being difficult to hit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where aiming could not be canceled after using throwable items when no throwable items are left.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombies rotating constantly when too close.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Karen's underwear sometimes not displaying.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clipping issues with underwear.[/p][/*][/list][p]Additions/Changes:[/p][list][*][p]Updated character animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated bullet count UI.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated melee invincibility duration.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated push collision range.[/p][/*][*][p]Auto-aim duration set to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Added blood splatter and wounds when knife hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Characters die when falling from high places.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimizations:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized UI coding.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced special effects.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.3v
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where long-pressing the cancel button sometimes speeds up the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem where map colors were not displayed correctly in hard mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the playground lighting dims during rainy weather.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors in the display of certain items.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing subtitles in the 2F room.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inability to switch weapons using hotkeys after loading a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the automatic respawn of flying insects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors in the display of certain maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed damage detection after an exploding egg is burned.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved zombie death animations for smoother movements.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing wall colors on certain floors of the school.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Optimized and improved the UI/UX of the dressing system.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the UI of the settings screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the mesh of corpses.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Additions/Modifications:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added volume settings for characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted environment brightness and color.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Korean and German language options.[/p][/*][*][p]Displayed selected difficulty level when saving.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an image system within documents.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced SP stamina when using push actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled simultaneous use of push actions and knife.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to sprint using the B key.[/p][/*][*][p]Added trajectory lines for throwable objects.[/p][/*][*][p]Allowed mouse usage when viewing documents.[/p][/*][*][p]Added surprise sound effects for headshots.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombie animations sometimes fail to sync when bitten.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.5.2v
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][h1][b]Hotfix 1.5.2v[/b][/h1][p]
[b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where sometimes no blood would appear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where monsters would sometimes stand back up (invincible) after death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where moving items back to their original slot would duplicate them.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where raising the gun was impossible after being attacked.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted character backlighting.[/p][/*][*][p]UI improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New/Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated weapon switching sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated gunshot effects on monsters.[/p][/*][*][p]Added immobilization effect for grenade explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated scene transitions to no longer require button inputs.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crawling speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Prevented dodging from bypassing explosions.[/p][/*][*][p]Added three new languages (French, Spanish, Russian).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombie animation sometimes does not sync when being bitten.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Demo 1.5.2v
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed zombies automatically facing the player upon rising.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some zombie attack animations not being executed.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted SP consumption for knife usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted knife attack power.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed occasional inability to aim after being attacked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some skill descriptions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed camera clipping into walls when bitten.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombies crawling under players.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some graphic settings not loading properly upon reload.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shotgun reloading exceeding the limit.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Optimizations:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved performance consumption of certain lighting effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Smoothed out transitions between some shooting animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated GPU animation skinning effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions/Modifications:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the impact range of flare grenades.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated shotgun shooting animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased shotgun penetration power.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of bullets fired per shotgun shot.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted shotgun reload limit to 4.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombie animations occasionally fail to synchronize when bitten.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Demo 1.5.1v
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where the character keeps raising their gun upon death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed aiming to temporarily target NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the problem of the gun disappearing when switching weapons due to being bitten.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dialogue errors when Ken turns into a zombie.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error allowing direction changes during evasion.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed display errors in certain one-way door maps.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Redesigned Ken's model.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified crawling animation to face forward.[/p][/*][*][p]Room maps now appear earlier.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled mouse movement for camera views upon death.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased headshot damage multiplier.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage to monster limbs.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced feedback for close-range hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased crawling speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced chances of incorrect leg-kicking after evasion.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated grenade throwing animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added functionality to use lighting to detonate explosive eggs.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted explosive egg respawn times.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tutorial levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved document and item UI.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added functionality to open the inventory with the ESC key.[/p][/*][*][p]Added preloaded shaders.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Known Issues[/b][/p][list][*][p]Zombie animations sometimes fail to sync when killed.[/p][/*][*][p]Occasionally unable to perform gun-raising actions after being attacked.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix Demo 1.5v
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048665/b35979c63463d3c034932faf099f1a01984245bf.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the issue with the volume button error.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the option to select the number of bullets to load.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the outfit change interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of being able to press MENU upon death.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the zombie idle animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated zombie sound effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the blood decal normal map for headshots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the error in running speed changes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of no footstep sounds while running occasionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the hit range for pistols.[/p][/*][*][p]Enabled aiming during mid-back jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated to ensure each save has its own route and does not jump to other routes without restarting.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to discard unwanted items at specific times.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where hair would sometimes not display correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated character skin textures.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue of eyelashes not being displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the weapon-switching animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated environmental icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Added SSGI settings.[/p][/*][/list]
